ranked.name: Hypochlorous acid face and body spray 2-pack, 3.4 oz
ranked.angle: Opaque, stable bottle with a dated expiry and cosmetic-only positioning against Briotech and Ulta brands.
ranked.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA (facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling). Avoid 'treats acne/eczema' (drug) and 'disinfects/kills germs' (likely EPA FIFRA pesticide claims). Amazon beauty may require documents.
ranked.notes: Exploding Topics: 148,400 searches/mo, +8,900% over 5 years. Pravada US private label: MOQ 50-250 units, sample $8.45, no per-unit price published. Marketplace China listings $0.65-1.06/unit (unverified). I assumed $3/unit US contract-filled (2-pack = $6) and 0% duty because it is US-filled; imported components are not counted. Orders/yr 1.8 is a guess (unit lasts ~2 months). Competition and complaint scores are judgment, not measured review counts.

ranked.name: Fluoride-free nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste, 3-pack of 3.4 oz tubes
ranked.angle: Smooth 10% nHA formula in a 3-pack with a refill option, positioned against Boka and Apagard.
ranked.regulatory_notes: Fluoride-free toothpaste is generally a cosmetic: MoCRA facility registration, product listing, ingredient labeling. Do not claim to prevent cavities or remineralize enamel (drug claims). Fluoride versions are OTC drugs.
ranked.notes: Exploding Topics: 43,300 searches/mo, +6,200% over 5 years. Chinese listings $0.19-0.80/tube at MOQ 20-10,000 (bare product, no tube/box/landed cost). Cinoll says it treats fluoride-free toothpaste as a MoCRA cosmetic (supplier claim). I used $2.50/tube boxed. Duty = assumed 7.5% List 4A + 12.5%; HTS list status not confirmed. Orders/yr 1.8 is a guess.

ranked.name: Creatine monohydrate gummies, 60 count (private label)
ranked.angle: Third-party-tested gummies with the full 5 g dose per serving and a clean sugar profile.
ranked.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement: cGMP (21 CFR 111), FDA facility registration, Supplement Facts panel, no disease claims, adverse event reporting. Amazon requires supplement category approval and third-party test reports. Imported food-type goods need FDA prior notice.
ranked.notes: Exploding Topics: 117,700/mo, +5,200% over 5 years. Alibaba listings show $1.50-5.00 per unit at MOQ ~100 boxes to 2,000 bottles; claims of FDA/NSF are seller assertions. Many gummies fail the dose claim (5 g does not fit in a gummy), which is also a lawsuit risk. Competition is dominated by big brands. Duty guess.
